capacity_gross_kwh.notes: Quick web lookup (rough, not cross-checked). Gross capacity.

chemistry.notes: Both EV9 packs NMC (SK On) per EV Seekers; EV Database lists NMC for the 99.8 kWh pack.

preconditioning.notes: Manual switch plus conditioning timed to a fast charger set as waypoint/destination (MV1 2026 manual; MV1 is the EV9 per the en_US specs page). Cited page is the UK copy; the en_US copy of this page was not found. Manual says the feature applies only to vehicles with a battery heater.

capacity_usable_kwh.notes: EV Database (European listing) 96.0 kWh usable for the 99.8 kWh pack; page marks it estimated. Australian Kia fact sheet also says 96.

ac_max_kw.notes: US Kia spec sheet via dealer: onboard charger 10.9 (unit omitted on page). US Wind is AWD, Canadian Wind here is RWD; onboard charger assumed identical.

dc_max_kw.notes: EV Database: Kia claimed maximum 210 kW for the 99.8 kWh pack (EV Database measured 209). InsideEVs measured 216 kW.

published_10_80_min.notes: US Kia spec via dealer: 24 min at 350 kW (CCS). Kia notes NACS/Supercharger times are longer.
